_doc: How every texture under godot/data is imported. tools/import_policy.py --write applies it to the .import files, --check exits 1 on drift. The first rule whose prefix matches a file's folder wins; 'params' are written into the [params] block. Big pictures go lossy WebP (lossless ctex was 3.7x the jpg: the APK hit 1.2 GB); small icons stay lossless so they stay crisp. A rule with max_width only matches images that narrow: the old 1024-wide CGs / battle pictures stay lossless (user: they looked blurry once compressed again on a phone).
